definitions.explanation: A group of people organized and sent to explore, research, or accomplish a specific mission in a distant or challenging location.
A military force dispatched to fight in a foreign territory.

examples.japanese: {遠征隊|えんせいたい}を{編成|へんせい}する。
{南極|なんきょく}{遠征隊|えんせいたい}が{出発|しゅっぱつ}した。
{登山|とざん}{遠征隊|えんせいたい}は{悪天候|あくてんこう}のため{頂上|ちょうじょう}への{挑戦|ちょうせん}を{断念|だんねん}した。
examples.english: The mountaineering expedition gave up its attempt on the summit due to bad weather.

examples.japanese: {遠征隊|えんせいたい}が{派遣|はけん}された。
{歴史|れきし}の{授業|じゅぎょう}でモンゴル{遠征隊|えんせいたい}について{学|まな}んだ。
examples.english: In history class, we studied the Mongol expeditionary force.

examples.japanese: {大規模|だいきぼ}な{遠征隊|えんせいたい}が{海|うみ}を{渡|わた}って{敵地|てきち}に{上陸|じょうりく}した。
examples.english: A large-scale expeditionary force crossed the sea and landed in enemy territory.

notes:
A compound of {遠征|えんせい} (expedition) and {隊|たい} (group, squad, party). Can refer to both civilian exploration/research expeditions and military expeditionary forces. In modern usage, sense 1 (civilian expedition) is more common, especially in contexts of mountaineering, polar exploration, and scientific research.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {登山|とざん}{遠征隊|えんせいたい}: mountaineering expedition
- {南極|なんきょく}{遠征隊|えんせいたい}: Antarctic expedition
- {探検|たんけん}{遠征隊|えんせいたい}: exploration expedition
- {遠征隊|えんせいたい}を{派遣|はけん}する: to dispatch an expedition
- {遠征隊|えんせいたい}を{組|く}む: to form an expedition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {探検隊|たんけんたい}: exploration party — focuses on discovering unknown areas
- {調査隊|ちょうさたい}: survey/research team — focuses on investigation and data collection
- {遠征|えんせい}: expedition — the act or event itself, without the group implication
